description: Scrape Marginal Revolution book reviews, analyze sentiment, and rank books by how positively Tyler Cowen feels about them

userStories.title: Create project structure and requirements.txt
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Python project scaffolding with all required dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Create requirements.txt with: requests, beautifulsoup4, vaderSentiment, spacy, lxml
Create main.py with CLI argument parsing using argparse (subcommands: scrape, analyze, rankings, status)
Create db.py module for database operations
Create scraper.py module for web scraping
Create analyzer.py module for NLP and sentiment analysis
Script runs without errors: python main.py --help

userStories.title: Create SQLite database schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database schema to store posts, books, and their relationships.
acceptanceCriteria: Create init_db() function in db.py that creates SQLite database file (mr_books.db)
Create posts table with: id, url (unique), title, date_published, content_html, content_text, scraped_at
Create books table with: id, title, author, sentiment_score, genre, created_at
Create book_mentions table with: id, book_id, post_id, context_text, sentiment_score, UNIQUE(book_id, post_id)
Create scrape_progress table with: id, page_number, completed_at
Database initializes successfully when running: python -c 'from db import init_db; init_db()'
Script runs without errors

userStories.title: Scrape category listing pages
userStories.description: As a user, I want to scrape all post URLs from the Books category pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scrape_category_listing() function in scraper.py
Fetches https://marginalrevolution.com/marginalrevolution/category/books and subsequent pages
Extracts post URL, title, and date from each listing item
Handles pagination by finding 'next page' link until no more pages
Implements 1-2 second delay between requests
Stores scraped page numbers in scrape_progress table
Logs progress to terminal (e.g., 'Scraped page 5, found 10 posts')
Script runs without errors: python main.py scrape --listing-only

userStories.title: Scrape individual post content
userStories.description: As a user, I want to fetch and store the full content of each post.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scrape_post_content() function in scraper.py
Fetches each post URL from the posts table where content_text is NULL
Extracts main post body content (not sidebar or comments)
Stores both HTML and cleaned text in posts table
Implements retry logic for network errors (3 retries with exponential backoff)
Implements 1-2 second delay between requests
Logs progress (e.g., 'Scraped post 150/1200: [title]')
Script runs without errors: python main.py scrape

userStories.title: Implement status command
userStories.description: As a user, I want to check the progress of scraping.
acceptanceCriteria: Create get_scrape_status() function in db.py
Returns: total posts in DB, posts with content scraped, last scrape timestamp
python main.py status prints formatted status to terminal
Shows number of pages scraped, posts found, posts with content
Script runs without errors

userStories.title: Extract book titles using NLP
userStories.description: As a user, I want the system to identify book titles in posts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create extract_books_from_post() function in analyzer.py
Uses spaCy NER to find WORK_OF_ART entities as potential book titles
Also detects italicized text (<em> or <i> tags) as potential book titles
Detects patterns like 'I recommend [title]', 'just finished [title]', 'new book [title]'
Stores extracted book titles in books table
Creates book_mentions records linking books to posts
Stores context (surrounding paragraph) in book_mentions.context_text
Script runs without errors

userStories.title: Implement book deduplication
userStories.description: As a user, I want books mentioned across multiple posts to be recognized as the same book.
acceptanceCriteria: Create find_or_create_book() function in db.py
Uses fuzzy string matching to detect similar titles (e.g., 'The Great Gatsby' vs 'Great Gatsby')
Normalizes titles (lowercase, strip articles) before comparison
If match found with >85% similarity, links to existing book instead of creating new
Script runs without errors

userStories.title: Perform sentiment analysis on book mentions
userStories.description: As a user, I want sentiment scores calculated for each book.
acceptanceCriteria: Create analyze_sentiment() function in analyzer.py
Uses VADER SentimentIntensityAnalyzer on each book_mention.context_text
Stores compound score (-1 to 1) in book_mentions.sentiment_score
Calculates average sentiment across all mentions for each book
Stores aggregated score in books.sentiment_score
python main.py analyze processes all unanalyzed book_mentions
Script runs without errors

userStories.title: Display ranked book list
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see books ranked by sentiment score.
acceptanceCriteria: Create get_ranked_books() function in db.py
Returns books sorted by sentiment_score descending
Includes all post URLs where each book is mentioned
python main.py rankings prints: rank, title, score, post links
Supports --top N flag to limit results (e.g., --top 50)
Output is readable in terminal (aligned or formatted list)
Script runs without errors

userStories.title: (Nice to Have) Categorize books by genre
userStories.description: As a user, I want books tagged with genres for filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Create categorize_book() function in analyzer.py
Uses keyword matching on post content to assign genres: history, economics, fiction, biography, science, philosophy, other
Stores genre in books.genre column
python main.py rankings --genre [genre] filters results
Script runs without errors

userStories.title: Fix pagination bug for pages 9+
userStories.description: As a user, I want pagination to work correctly beyond page 8 so all posts are scraped.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix scrape_category_listing() to correctly identify the 'next page' link
Do not follow Amazon or other external links as pagination URLs
Handle ellipsis pagination correctly - when on page 9, page 10 may be hidden behind '...' but the 'next' or '>' link should still work
Validate that pagination URLs match the pattern: marginalrevolution.com/marginalrevolution/category/books/page/N
Skip invalid URLs like '#' or external domains
Successfully scrapes pages 9, 10, and beyond without errors
Script runs without errors: python main.py scrape --listing-only
userStories.notes: Fixed by adding is_valid_pagination_url() validation function that filters out external domains, anchor links, and ensures URLs match the expected pagination pattern.
